name: Pulse
description: Activity heatmap, pull requests waiting on you, and a git panel for the focused workspace.

settings.title: Show Claude plan limits
settings.description: Reads the Claude Code OAuth token (macOS keychain or ~/.claude/.credentials.json) into memory and sends it only to api.anthropic.com to read your 5-hour and 7-day usage. Never stored or logged.

settings.title: Notify on pull request changes
settings.description: Desktop notification when a pull request becomes ready to merge or its CI fails.

settings.title: AI commit and PR messages
settings.description: Sends the staged diff (secret-looking files excluded, 24 KB max) to your local claude CLI when you press message or create pr.

settings.title: Pull requests to show
settings.description: Which pull requests the list shows, matched by each workspace's GitHub origin remote.

settings.title: Review requested pull requests automatically
settings.description: Starts the Claude review on its own when someone requests your review on a pull request whose repository is open in a local workspace. Claude reads the pull request without a click.

settings.title: Let reviews approve
settings.description: When on, a clean review approves the pull request, and a change request starts a follow-up loop that approves once your feedback is addressed. When off, a clean review only leaves a comment and no follow-up starts.

settings.title: Merge pull requests Pulse reviewed
settings.description: Merges a pull request Pulse reviewed once it is approved on its latest commit, your own approval is on that commit, checks pass and GitHub reports it ready. Never bypasses branch protection.

settings.title: Merge method
settings.description: How Pulse merges when automatic merging is on.

settings.title: Follow-up loop interval (minutes)
settings.description: How often the follow-up loop checks a pull request you requested changes on, when Let reviews approve is on. Whole minutes from 1 to 1440.
